observation_discipline: Exposure was observed in this run before delegation and recorded append-only. The write-once register authored by controller bc-13b664e4 was left byte-identical; this run's differing observation is recorded alongside it at workstreams/po03/control/model-exposure-observations.jsonl rather than overwriting it.

lead_integrator.actual: claude-opus-5-thinking-max as the controller; claude-opus-5-thinking-high for delegated lead engineering
lead_integrator.note: the controller runs a strictly stronger reasoning encoding than the required high setting

independent_chief_challenger.required: gpt-5.6-sol at the highest exposed reasoning setting

independent_long_context_and_alternative.required: gemini-3.1-pro at its highest exposed setting
independent_long_context_and_alternative.observed_boundary: gemini-3.1-pro is absent from the delegation model enumeration exposed to this run; no exact configuration is selectable
independent_long_context_and_alternative.handling: The role was distributed across gpt-5.6-luna-high and claude-sonnet-5-thinking-xhigh, which are distinct exposed families. No gemini availability, gemini output or gemini-derived diversity is claimed anywhere in this wave.

composer_2_5.required: used only as a distinct harness hypothesis or on preregistered matched evidence; never as a cheaper substitute
composer_2_5.observed_boundary: composer-2.5 is absent from the delegation model enumeration exposed to this run

policy_compliance.auto_model_basis: every subordinate was dispatched with an exact logged configuration; Auto was never selected
policy_compliance.cost_treatment: cost is measured as an operating property, not used as a downgrade rule; no unit was moved to a weaker configuration to reduce spend

heterogeneity.adversarial_review_requirement: blind adversarial review from at least two different frontier families when exposed
heterogeneity.adversarial_review_note: cohort c8 units 059 and 060 own hidden-case generation and the blind-review harness, and were instructed to prefer a reviewer family different from their own producing family and to record any cross-family spawn refusal verbatim

route_canary_exception.reason: the configuration was frozen in an immutable capsule authored by a prior controller run; honouring frozen immutable input was preferred over substituting this run's preferred configuration
route_canary_exception.downgrade_basis: a -fast suffix is a provider throughput encoding at the same reasoning tier, not a lower reasoning setting

weaker_configuration_policy: A weaker configuration is admissible only after a frozen paired evaluation demonstrates a functional advantage for that work class. No such evaluation was run and no weaker configuration was substituted, so this list is empty by fact rather than by omission.
self_observation_limitation: A subordinate generally cannot verify the model actually serving it. Dispatched configurations are recorded exactly; where a producer could not observe its own served identity it was instructed to record that as NOT_SUPPORTED rather than assert the dispatched value as observed.
